title: Navigation voice command timing and nearest station availability
summary: The feedback combines one positive note about navigation voice-command behavior and one undetermined mention of the nearest charging station being frequently unavailable.

positive.summary: One positive review describes the navigation system requiring a prompt before accepting a spoken destination request such as the closest Starbucks.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review mentions that the charging station closest to the reviewer’s residence is frequently down, without enough context to assign sentiment toward the vehicle.

limitations: The topic mixes two different subjects—navigation voice interaction and external charging-station availability—so the examples do not form a single coherent issue.
Only two fragments are available, which is too little to infer broader patterns beyond these specific examples.
